name: io.liftoff.vungleads
description: Liftoff/Vungle Ads Unity plugin for Android and iOS. Supports interstitial, rewarded, banner, and native ad formats. Bundles native Android AARs and iOS Objective-C plugins; resolves the VungleAds SDK via External Dependency Manager (EDM4U).

samples.description: Example scenes and scripts for interstitial, rewarded, banner, and native ads.
